title: rosa × damascena var. balcanica
intro: Rosa × damascena var. balcanica, commonly known as the Balkan Damask rose, is a fragrant, pink-flowering rose plant native to the Balkan Peninsula. This plant is valued for its essential oil, which is extracted from the flowers and has numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × damascena var. balcanica include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality due to its calming and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
